title: Felling trees to prepare a farm
rule: Felling trees for farm preparation or other land use needs a permit from the District Forest Manager after approval by the District Committee.
checks: Who owns and uses the land
penalty: 1 to 50 acres: fine of TSh 3,000,000 to 5,000,000, or 1 to 2 years in prison, or both. Above 50 acres: fine of TSh 10,000,000 to 12,000,000, or 2 to 5 years in prison, or both.
flag: No penalty is stated for land under one acre.
